learning_outcomes.text: Explain the legacies of antiquity and the shape of medieval European society
Analyse the Renaissance, Reformation and the fracturing of Christendom
Trace the rise of states, absolutism and the Enlightenment
Evaluate the French Revolution, industrialisation and the age of nationalism
Explain the causes and consequences of the two world wars
Assess division, integration and change in Europe since 1945

integrative_case: A European broadcaster commissions a six-part series on 'how modern Europe was made': select the turning points, justify each against alternatives, and show how religion, revolution, industry and war interact rather than following a single storyline.
